description: Lase model min laɲinilen do ka daminɛ ka kuma, walima ka Hub la ɲini ka do wɛrɛ sɔrɔ.
quickStartFailed: Fɛn tɛ se ka kɛ. K'a ɲini kokura.
exploreHub: Ɲinini kɛ suguya wɛrɛw kan Hub kɔnɔ
checkModelResolving: K'a ɲini a ka ɲɛnamaya la...
checkSystemFailed: A tɛ se ka minɛnw kunnafoni kalaya
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} ye CPU-kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye, o la {{gpus}} bɛ to ka baara kɛ. Ka se ka GPU backend sugandi ka se Dakunw la ka a labaara.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} mako be {{vendor}} GPU la, nka Novera ye {{gpus}} sɔrɔ. Novera bɛ baara kɛ CPU kan.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} tɛ se ka don do GPU la, o la Novera bɛ baara kɛ ni CPU ye. O bɛ a yira tuma dow la ko GPU ka baarakɛla walima ka baara kɛ waati ka kan ka fisaya.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} tɛ se ka daminɛ sabu sɛbɛnmarayɔrɔ min ka kan mankan ({{libraries}}), o la Novera bɛ baara kɛ ni CPU ye.
checkEngineProbeFailed: A ma se k'a yira ko motɛriman bɛ se ka GPU labaara
checkEngineUnavailable: Nin motɛriman labɛnin tɛ se ka GPU jɔyɔrɔ jira
checkSearchPreparing: K'a labaarali kɛ ni embedding model ye...
checkSearchNoVector: Embedding model ma jabi sɔrɔ, o la faili ɲinini tɛ baara kɛ hali bi
checkSearchInvalidVector: Embedding model ye baarakɛbaliya jabi sɔrɔ, o la faili ɲinini bɛ se ka kɛ a tɛ sɔrɔ
checkSearchProbeFailed: A ma se ka modeli faralen kan sɛgɛsɛgɛ
checkSearchUnavailable: Nin motɛriman labɛnin tɛ se ka modeli faralen ɲɔgɔn kan sɛgɛsɛgɛ
stageConsent: K'i dɛmɛ ka Novera ɲɛtaa di
welcomeTitle: Novera kan ka se ka segin a kan a ka sisitɛmu kan
welcomeBody: Nin bɛ munu damadɔ ta: Novera bɛ a ka inferiɔn motɛriman ani a ka fitini motɛriman min bɛ se ka fayilo ɲinini kɛ. A bɛ se ka baara kɛ ni ɔridinatɛri ye tuma min a bɛ baara kɛ.
badgeGpu: A ka kan ka GPU labaara.
badgeCpu: A bɛ kɛ ka taa CPU
otherWarnings: {{count}} sɛgɛsɛgɛli wɛrɛw fana kan ka jatɛminɛ.
setupDoneBody: Novera bena sigida modɛliw baara ni llama.cpp ye.
dsparkEnable: Baara kɛ ni DSpark akasiyɔn ye (fagan)
dsparkDescription: A bɛ DSpark Q8_0 ka baarakɛla ({{size}}) ladon LFM2.5-2.6B kama. A bɛ se ka baara kɛ ka telin, nga a bɛ RAM walima VRAM fara a kan, ka memori fitini to ka baara kɛ a kan. A bɛ se ka jatɛminɛ a kan a ka baarakɛ minɛnw kan; ka baara kɛ a kan ka baara kɛ a kan walima ka speculative decoding bali modeli labɛncogo la.
